newsitem.title: FRANCE: Social worries, weak franc weigh on French stocks.
newsitem.headline: Social worries, weak franc weigh on French stocks.

text.p: French stocks opened lower on Thursday, pressured by weakness in the franc and concerns that French labour unions are preparing to challenge the conservative government in the autumn over its social and economic policies.
"We're looking at a context similar to that of November 1995 (when public sector unions struck for three weeks), possibly worse," a trader said.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 13.95 points, or 0.7 percent, at 1,988.95 at 0840 GMT, while the CAC-40 futures contract was 10.5 points lower at 1,991.
Force Ouvriere head Marc Blondel on Thursday joined a chorus of union leaders predicting a difficult autumn for the government.
